The '''Detention Taskforce''' was created by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] when they realized they needed a solution to the criminal problem within the borders of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Initially, the Authority believed that crime would be no problem in their "model corporate society," but this view proved to be wrong and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was uninterested in dealing with criminals violating Authority law. The conclusions of the Detention Taskforce led to the decision that those criminals considered unreformable&mdash;such as those who refused to adapt to a labor colony or change their ways&mdash;required a permanent penal facility. As a result, [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] was approved and constructed on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
